The '''fire-control chamber''' was located aboard [[Centerpoint Station]]. It was from here that the station would be fired.

==Description==
The fire-control chamber was a large area with consoles, datajacks, keyboards, monitors, and readouts everywhere. One open area used to hold [[Anakin Sal-Solo]], who thought it was [[Anakin Solo]], and was twice as tall as a normal [[Human/Legends|Human]]. It was from this chamber that [[Centerpoint Station]] was targeted and fired. From this chamber it was also possible to view the security [[Holocamera/Legends|cams]] around the station.<ref name="Fury" />

==History==
During the [[Second Galactic Civil War]] the [[Corellia/Legends|Corellian]] leadership lured [[Colonel/Legends|Colonel]] [[Darth Caedus|Solo]], one of the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances]] [[Chief of State (Galactic Alliance)|Chiefs of State]] into a [[Battle of the rendezvous point|trap]], with the promise of Corellia's surrender. During the battle the plan was to fire Centerpoint, destroying the [[Anakin Solo (starship)|''Anakin Solo'']] and [[Death/Legends|killing]] Colonel Solo, as well as taking out part of the [[Second Fleet (Galactic Alliance)|Galactic Alliance Second Fleet]]. After firing, however, the ''Anakin Solo'' was not destroyed, Solo was not killed, and the fire-control chamber caught fire due to the [[Corellian/Legends|Corellians]] going around the security measures that were in place to allow Anakin Solo, or the [[Droid/Legends|droid]] that believed it was Anakin. When [[Five World Prime Minister|Prime Minister of the Five Worlds]] [[Sadras Koyan]] asked what had happened, [[Rikel (Centerpoint Station)|Vibro]] gave him a more simplistic explanation of what had happened to the station's systems, and why the fire-control chamber was malfunctioning.<ref name="Fury" />

When Solo led the Alliance in an attempt to [[Battle of Centerpoint Station (Second Galactic Civil War)|capture]] Centerpoint Station, the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] were attempting to destroy the station. One plan involved the [[Scientist/Legends|scientist]] [[Toval Seyah]] to reprogram the station, in the fire-control chamber, to overload instead of firing.<ref name="Fury" />

When Koyan left the station, Vibro watched him with the security cams from the fire-control chamber. He also took it upon himself to fire on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] in revenge for his wife, causing Centerpoint Station to be destroyed. This was because Seyah was able to reprogram the star data in Centerpoint's systems, and reset all the other coordinates as the center of [[Hollowtown]].<ref name="Fury" />
